main_subject.description: An adult East Asian woman with long flowing dark hair and a natural candid smile.
main_subject.wardrobe: A black zip-front jacket over a plain ivory crew-neck top and high-waisted dark trousers.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Standing comfortably beside a rooftop railing, head turned slightly into the wind.

composition_elements.setting: Safe rooftop terrace at sunset with a generic blurred city skyline and no identifiable buildings.
composition_elements.framing: 85mm close-medium portrait with hair rim-lit and skyline softened.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No logo, building signage, text, watermark, or celebrity likeness.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Warm sunset backlight with soft glow around hair and natural facial fill.

technical_specs.rendering: Natural skin, wind-touched hair, soft bokeh, fine grain, and realistic architecture.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical professional golden-hour portrait of an adult East Asian woman with long flowing dark hair and a natural candid smile. She wears a black zip-front jacket over a plain ivory crew-neck top and high-waisted dark trousers. Place her standing comfortably beside a rooftop railing at sunset, head turned slightly into the wind, with a generic blurred city skyline behind. Use 85mm close-medium framing, warm rim light around hair, natural face fill, soft bokeh, fine grain, realistic architecture, and natural skin. No logo, building signage, readable text, watermark, or celebrity likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, unsafe rooftop pose, logo, readable text, watermark, plastic skin, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Optional identity references must show a consenting adult. Rooftop and wardrobe references are replaceable and must have all branded or readable content removed.
